content.user_title: Verify NEAR AI Cloud Private Inference
content.value_statement: Private AI deployments need proof that prompts and responses stay inside trusted hardware. This skill guides NEAR AI Cloud integration, attestation checks, and signed response verification.
actual_capabilities: Configure OpenAI-compatible SDK clients for the NEAR AI Cloud base URL.
Select NEAR AI Cloud models by privacy type, cost, context size, and task fit.
Request model attestation reports with fresh nonces.
Verify NVIDIA GPU attestation fields and Intel TDX quote requirements.
Connect attested signing addresses to chat response signatures.
Explain private versus anonymised model tradeoffs.
limitations: Does not provide working gateway verification or encrypted chat implementation.
Requires valid NEAR AI Cloud credentials and access to supported endpoints.
Relies on external attestation services and current NEAR AI Cloud documentation.
Does not independently validate model pricing or availability in real time.

use_cases.title: Build Private AI Features
use_cases.description: Application developers can route OpenAI-compatible clients to NEAR AI Cloud while preserving private inference requirements.

use_cases.title: Audit TEE Attestation
use_cases.description: Security engineers can review nonce handling, NVIDIA NRAS fields, Intel TDX checks, and signing address binding.

use_cases.title: Choose Cloud Models
use_cases.description: Product teams can compare private and anonymised models for cost, context size, privacy, and capability fit.

prompt_templates.title: Start a NEAR Client
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to configure an OpenAI-compatible client for NEAR AI Cloud. Use the base URL and a placeholder API key.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the listed NEAR AI Cloud models for my coding assistant. Explain privacy type, context size, cost, and task fit.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Attestation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a verification checklist for a model attestation response. Include nonce freshness, NVIDIA NRAS fields, Intel TDX checks, and signing address binding.

prompt_templates.title: Design Trust Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an end-to-end trust flow for private chat responses. Include attestation, message signatures, replay protection, and operational failure cases.

output_examples.input: I need to add NEAR AI Cloud to an existing OpenAI SDK integration.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a concise migration plan with the NEAR base URL, credential placement, model selection, and verification follow-up.

output_examples.input: I need to confirm a model runs inside trusted hardware.
output_examples.output: The skill produces an attestation checklist covering fresh nonces, NVIDIA result fields, Intel TDX quote validation, and signer matching.

output_examples.input: I need to choose between private and anonymised models.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes model options by privacy type, context size, cost, and recommended workloads.

best_practices: Generate a fresh random nonce for every attestation request.
Verify both GPU attestation and Intel TDX evidence before trusting signatures.
Store API keys in environment variables or a secret manager.
anti_patterns: Treating an OpenAI-compatible response as private without attestation checks.
Reusing old attestation reports after nonce or token expiration.
Selecting models by name without checking privacy type and cost.

faq.question: Does this skill call NEAR AI Cloud by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides integration and verification guidance. Your agent or code makes calls when you ask it to.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include complete verifier code?
faq.answer: No. It points to verification concepts and references, but complete implementations remain external.

faq.question: What credentials are needed?
faq.answer: You need a NEAR AI Cloud API key from the service dashboard.

faq.question: Can it verify chat signatures?
faq.answer: It explains the required chain of trust and signer matching. The current docs list full chat verification as planned.

faq.question: Is every model private?
faq.answer: No. The model guide distinguishes private models from anonymised models.
